title: Palindrome Partitioning
prompt: Given a string s, partition s such that every substring of the partition is a palindrome. Return all possible palindrome partitionings of s.
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters.
hints: Backtrack: at each position, try cutting after 1 char, 2 chars, etc. as long as the substring is a palindrome.
For start index: for end from start+1 to s.length, if s[start:end] is palindrome, add to path, recurse from end, backtrack.
Helper isPal(s, i, j) checks if s[i:j] is palindrome.
O(2^n * n) - at each position we can cut or not.
